function.name: navigate_symbol
function.description: Find exact definitions or one-hop callees/callers of an identifier. Returns up to six locations; unresolved dynamic calls are explicit. No source evidence: read returned lines with read_code.

function.name: search_code
function.description: Search source/tests; returns at most 3 source units, bounded by bytes. Use English identifiers; match=literal for an exact substring. Empty results: change query. Optional path is exact; path_prefix limits to a directory BEFORE retrieval. Truncated hits include next_line; read remaining relevant lines with read_code.

function.name: search_docs
function.description: Search README/docs/config (not source). Same bounded locations/excerpts as search_code. Use English keywords; path/path_prefix filter BEFORE retrieval; empty results do not prove absence.

function.name: read_code
function.description: Read exact source or documentation lines from the snapshot. Supply path, start_line, end_line. Optional expand=symbol includes the enclosing function/class/test. Bounded by the run's max_read_lines/max_read_bytes and serialized observation allowance. If truncated, continuation contains exact read_code arguments for the next unread interval. Continue only when that interval is relevant; only shown lines can be cited.

function.name: trace_dependencies
function.description: Resolve static local imports of one source path. Returns related paths, not a runtime call graph. External/dynamic imports may be unresolved; read returned paths before making claims.

function.name: find_tests
function.description: Find candidate tests for a source path, optionally with a symbol query. Returns short excerpts; read relevant test ranges to verify assertions. A match does not prove executed coverage.
